reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes joining OneCoin through paid packages, token-based mining, appreciation claims, and recruitment of additional participants. The speaker presents automated presentations, team duplication, inviting lots of people, and network and leadership bonuses as the method for building a business, while encouraging viewers to continue to the compensation plan and lock in a position. These combined claims and recruitment instructions actively solicit participation rather than neutrally explaining cryptocurrency.

opening.argument: The presentation expressly qualifies its financial examples instead of presenting them as guaranteed returns: the speaker calls them “simply predictions” and says they are “not financial forecast” and “for educational purposes only.” The discussion also invites questions rather than claiming to answer everything, stating that if every question were answered, “that's probably not a good sign.” That framing supports treating the material as conditional financial commentary and an introductory presentation, not a promise that viewers will profit. The examples are presented as possibilities for consideration, with the audience encouraged to investigate further before proceeding.

citations.quote: these are simply predictions are not financial forecast
Again, this is just a prediction, it's not a financial forecast and it's for educational purposes only
I always tell people if I answer all your questions, that's probably not a good sign

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited packages, invitations, bonuses, and “lock in” language show that the presentation promotes an opportunity, but they do not establish that any return is guaranteed or that participation is fraudulent. The prosecution also omits the explicit qualification that the growth scenarios are predictions, not financial forecasts, and presents a promotional call to continue as if it were proof of a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: these are simply predictions are not financial forecast
definitely go on to step number two and watch the compensation plan right now

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer does not neutralize the surrounding solicitation. The same presentation describes paid packages, urges viewers to invite others, identifies multiple bonuses, and tells them to “lock in your position.” Calling appreciation scenarios predictions limits one claim, but it does not explain away recruitment commissions or paid participation. The uncertainty language therefore does not change the central earning mechanism.

opening.argument: The primary material is structured as an educational walkthrough of cryptocurrency concepts and the platform's operating model. It explains an algorithm, mining, a blockchain, an exchange, and an e-wallet, including how tokens and coins are described as moving between those components. The speaker explicitly says the goal is to help viewers understand “what cryptocurrency is” and repeatedly explains technical concepts through an island example. The supplied slides likewise present labeled operational diagrams such as “Algorithm,” “Mining,” “Blockchain,” and “Exchange.” This is consistent with a technology and business-system demonstration, even if the presentation also promotes the subject.

citations.quote: The goal of the presentation is to get you to understand what cryptocurrency is
what I thought I would do in this presentation is giving the five components that make up a cryptocurrency
you simply just turn your tokens over to our mining operation

rebuttal.rebuttal: The technical explanation is not presented in isolation. It is embedded in a business introduction that promises access to tokens and coins, teaches automated recruitment, and directs viewers toward a compensation plan. Explaining how a claimed system works does not make the surrounding invitation merely educational when the speaker also tells viewers how to enroll others and build a team.

citations.quote: Our one coin promise, what we promise you today is to provide you with a simple three-step business introduction system
D is duplication of team
watch the compensation plan right now

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The diagrams and explanations are supporting material for the business offer, not a neutral technology lesson. The speaker connects the system to paid packages and mining tokens, then describes converting coins into cash and earning through a compensation plan. A technical vocabulary and labeled slides cannot erase the presentation's direct recruitment and monetization purpose.

You're going to turn those tokens over to our mining operations
the money is liquidated and put in to your account
we have direct sales compensation

opening.argument: The material can be understood as promoting an ordinary business service and its associated digital product, rather than documenting a completed scam. The speaker describes a marketing platform with Facebook presentations, reminder calls, chat rooms, automated posting, and lead-generation tools, and says the page can be copied into a user's own marketing system. The supplied frame identifies this as an “Alpha Team Facebook Presentation System” with setup and presentation components. Nothing supplied shows a completed signup, payment, withdrawal, or actual reward. The presentation describes a service and referral opportunity, but the evidence does not establish that a viewer was deceived or that a promised outcome occurred.

citations.quote: We have Facebook based presentations like the one you're looking at. We have a robo reminder calls, chat rooms for education, auto posting systems, and lead generation pools
it takes 5 minutes to set it up in its copy to your Facebook system

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a completed transaction is not decisive because scam promotion can solicit participation before completion. Here, the speaker describes packages supplying tokens for mining, recruitment-based bonuses, and binary compensation plans, then urges viewers to lock in a position. Those are not merely ordinary advertising tools; they describe the proposed earning structure and a direct path into it.

citations.quote: I'm going to offer 5 packages, ranging from €100 up to €5,000
we have direct sales compensation and this is in step two I go into greater detail we have our network bonus a matching bonuses, startup bonuses
these binary compensation plans are extremely powerful

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The lack of a completed payment does not make the offer ordinary commerce. The speaker expressly links packages to token mining, encourages inviting many people, and lists network, matching, startup, and leadership bonuses. The marketing tools are therefore presented as infrastructure for recruiting participants and selling access, not simply as an independent software service.
